evidence.reason: The runbook now enters Effects.controller_lock (the same controller.lock every controller transaction serializes on) immediately after Effects construction — before admission or any unit stop — and holds it through both checkout switches, the released health window, recovery and rollback, releasing it in run()'s finally beside deploy.lock, so controller --unit/deploy/rollback/recovery transactions refuse while a deploy runs and the runbook refuses while a controller transaction is in flight, with all acquisitions LOCK_NB so no deadlock is possible; tests were not run locally (harness permits no python), CI is the authority.
